characterDescription: Skarn, Hrolf Wolfshorn's giant elderly Gramnir/North wolf, 36 years old, quiet and regal despite his age. Exactly the WOLF in the reference: large broad old muzzle, thick gray-brown and strongly silvered layered fur, pale cream-gray cheeks, muzzle, eyebrows and long thick chest/neck mane, dark gray-brown forehead ridge and ear backs, BLACK nose, BOTH amber/golden-brown eyes with the exact natural eye shape, worn/nicked upright triangular ears as pictured. Preserve his precise skull and jaw shape, fur markings, characteristic subtle downward mouth corners, silhouette, mature age and dignified expression. He remains a natural four-legged wolf, never humanoid. The user's actual illustration has delicate uneven dark outlines, finely separated fur tufts, muted gray-brown/cream colors and restrained layered illustration shading with subtle texture. Match it exactly, not a bright generic anime wolf, puppy, photorealistic animal or stylized pet. Do not make him younger, add blindness, new scars, ornaments, clothing, armor, collar or harness.

panels.gesture: Head level and nearly frontal, both amber eyes steady and attentive, ears naturally upright, mouth gently closed, broad furry chest settled. Watchful without tension or threat.
A modest three-quarter head turn toward the viewer's right, relaxed half-lowered eyelids, calm sideways gaze and one ear slightly rotated outward, relaxed jaw. Same camera distance and full ears.
Head lifted slightly, chin raised with quiet noble bearing, eyes looking calmly into the middle distance, ears upright and chest naturally proud. No intimidating snarl or exaggerated anatomy.
Face near frontal with a tiny gentle head tilt, softened attentive eyes and relaxed ears, muzzle held loosely closed. Convey patient old-wolf warmth through eyes and posture, never a human smile.
Skull level with a slight downward inclination, unhurried amber gaze under relaxed lids, one ear tracking slightly to the side, neck mane resting naturally. Reflective, wise and composed.
A small gentle downward dip of the head, eyes briefly softened in a slow blink, ears at relaxed neutral angles, chest quiet and stable. A subtle accepting body-language cue, not bowed fear.
Head turned a little toward the viewer's right, eyes directed softly to a distant point just above eye level, ears aligned toward that direction, jaw relaxed. Quiet interest with no alert alarm.

Eyes peacefully almost closed during a slow rest, chin slightly lowered, heavy old neck/chest fur relaxed and upper shoulders settled. Keep dignified upright upper-body posture; not collapse, sleep on ground or full-body view.

A slight three-quarter turn back toward the viewer, head gently high, calm measured amber gaze and naturally upright ears with one subtly angled outward, mouth softly closed. Silent assurance and settled grandeur, different from the other poses.
